decision_classes.deterministic: Executed by versioned rules with the policy version as authority; no human sign-off (RR-REQ-X-007-r2).
decision_classes.ai-assisted: AI extracts, matches or proposes; the transition executes only after a deterministic guard verifies the proposal against quoted source spans, or a human accepts it. AI output is never itself a trigger (CNV-AIO-001/002).
decision_classes.human-required: Requires a named human with recorded authority; AI may prepare a dossier with deterministic findings rendered separately.

invariants: Only deterministic transitions run without a named human; their authority is the policy version.
No AI output is a trigger by itself; AI cannot publish or clear holds, place discretionary holds, or disposition sanctions matches.
CommonVerification moves only on public-source facts; sponsor-private information never changes a shared state (CNV-GRT-004).
Release requires StatusCurrent, SanctionsClearCurrentList, DestinationVerified and HoldVersionClear evaluated atomically at dispatch (CNV-ARC-003).
Unknown or un-ingested state fails closed for release and never yields Ineligible (UNB-CHAR-016, CA-180-13).
All numeric intervals come from FreshnessPolicy (UNB-RCN-GRT-014); none are hard-coded in this model.
Every claim and decision records valid time, source-publication time and recorded time (05 s5.2).
Retroactive reinstatement adds a valid-time correction; recorded-time history of holds is preserved and holds are counted as correct-then-lifted.

reinstatement_semantics.prospective: grants dated in [revocationEffective, reinstatementEffective) remain refused

freshness_semantics.current: latest publication of the source ingested
freshness_semantics.late_publication: source past expected cadence plus grace: alert only, no hold
freshness_semantics.ingest_failed: publication exists but not ingested: release fails safe
freshness_semantics.quarantined: schema drift or implausible delta: treated as ingest_failed until released

triggers.MigrationImport: Sponsor migration imported a legacy charity record (UNB-CHAR-041)

triggers.AutomatedGatheringExhausted: Bounded automated refresh and requests failed (retry budget spent)
triggers.EvidenceSubmitted: Charity, central org, fiscal sponsor or sponsor uploaded evidence (a claim until verified)
triggers.StewardAcceptsEvidence: Steward accepts submitted evidence after review
triggers.RenewalWindowOpened: Clock reached expiry minus refresh lead time (default 30 days, CNV-GRT-003) plus jitter
triggers.AutoRenewalPassed: Scheduled full review found all evidence current and passing
triggers.AutoRenewalFailed: Scheduled full review could not complete with current evidence
triggers.DeepReviewExpired: Clock passed deep-review max age (default 180 days)
triggers.StatusPublicationIngested: New posting of Pub 78, EO BMF or Auto-Revocation List ingested and validated
triggers.MaterialAdverseCandidate: Ingested change classified Material-Adverse-candidate by MaterialityTable (removed from Pub 78/BMF, group exit, final return)
triggers.VerifiedPublicAdverse: Adverse fact confirmed from a T1 source (revocation posted without reinstatement, subsection/foundation/deductibility adverse change, central org revoked)
triggers.MaterialNeutralChange: Name change same EIN, address change, favourable or neutral classification change
triggers.InformationalChange: Financial, filing or descriptive change with no eligibility, authority, payment or policy impact
triggers.ReinstatementObserved: Revocation list shows reinstatement date, or new Pub 78/BMF listing, or new determination letter
triggers.QualifyingRelistingOrLetter: Pub 78/BMF listing posted after the revocation posting, or determination letter effective on/before the date in question (Rev. Proc. 2018-32 s4.06)
triggers.NextCycleClears: Next publication cycle no longer shows the adverse candidate
triggers.AmbiguityPersists: Adverse candidate unresolved after two publication cycles and a grant is affected
triggers.SuccessorConfirmed: Steward confirms merger/consolidation successor from T1/T2 evidence and successor confirmation
triggers.IdentityMergeApproved: Dual-control steward approval to merge duplicate identities
triggers.UnmergeApproved: Dual-control steward approval to reverse a merge
triggers.SponsorEvaluationRequested: First grant recommendation for the charity in this sponsor, or overlay/policy version change, or CommonVerification change
triggers.SponsorDiscretionaryHoldPlaced: Authorized sponsor officer places hold under board DiscretionaryGrantPolicy (CNV-GRT-005)
triggers.DiscretionaryHoldReviewDue: Hold review deadline reached (max 90 days, renewable once on new evidence)
triggers.SponsorExclusionAdded: Sponsor adds charity to its restricted list (UNB-CHAR-031)
triggers.HoldPublished: Shared or sponsor hold version affecting this charity published
triggers.HoldLifted: Hold removed by its owning process
triggers.DonorCancelled: Donor or sponsor cancelled the grant
triggers.DispatchCommitted: Rail partner accepted the instruction inside the fenced transaction
triggers.OccurrenceDue: Recurring schedule reached an occurrence date
triggers.ListUpdated: Sanctions list version published (SDN update day)
triggers.TrueMatchConfirmed: Authorized compliance officer confirms true match
triggers.ComplianceDecision: Compliance officer selects Block, Reject or Proceed (licence/exemption) (CNV-GRT-006)
triggers.DispositionInvalidated: Subject attribute change, list entry hash change, new matching entry, 12 months elapsed, or officer authority revoked
triggers.SourceObserved: Source record captured with payload hash and posting date
triggers.ValidationPassed: Schema, parser and plausibility checks passed
triggers.ValidationFailed: Schema drift, parser failure or implausible delta (UNB-KNOW-026)
triggers.QuarantineReleased: Data steward approves quarantined batch after repair
triggers.ExpiryApproaching: Evidence validity end minus refresh lead time
triggers.EvidenceValidityEnded: Validity rule of the evidence type ended
triggers.NewerVersionCurrent: A newer version of the same evidence became Current
triggers.DisputeFiled: Charity or sponsor disputes the evidence (UNB-CHAR-014/017)
triggers.DocumentExtractionVerified: AI-extracted fact from an unstructured public document (final return, merger filing, central-org directory) verified by deterministic check against the quoted source span
triggers.SourceRetracted: Source withdrew or corrected the record (e.g. IRS-flagged erroneous revocation dates)

guards.IdentityConfidenceOK: Resolution outcome is Resolved or ResolvedWithConditions (05 section 4.1)
guards.RulesPass: Platform deterministic rules pass on Current T1 evidence for the entity type
guards.EntityTypeMatrixPath: Entity is church, government unit, group subordinate, disregarded entity or newly recognized org satisfied via UNB-RCN-GRT-013 matrix
guards.NoOpenAdverse: No unresolved Material-Adverse candidate or shared hold
guards.SponsorDelegationRecorded: Sponsor board delegation for policy-approved items recorded (CNV-GRT-001)
guards.RecipientClassEnabled: Recipient class enabled for sponsor and release (CNV-GRT-002)
guards.OverlayPasses: Sponsor overlay rules pass (can only tighten)
guards.OverlayNeedsHuman: Overlay rule outcome is NeedsReview (non-standard class, fraud signal, policy ambiguity)
guards.StatusCurrent: Status evidence is from the latest ingested publication and no newer publication is un-ingested
guards.DeepReviewCurrentForApproval: CommonVerification not Expired (approval only; release does not require it, RR-REQ-X-007-r1)
guards.SanctionsClearCurrentList: Screening against current list version is Clear or valid FalsePositive
guards.DestinationVerified: CNV-PAY-002 destination evidence current, or networked rail enrolment
guards.HoldVersionClear: Hold registry version read atomically shows no applicable hold (CNV-ARC-003); unknown => fail
guards.GrantDateCovered: Reinstated validity covers the grant date and a qualifying relisting or letter exists
guards.WithinHoldWindow: Occurrence still inside sponsor hold window
guards.ReuseAllowed: FP disposition within 12 months, same subject attributes, same entry hash, same sponsor (R1)
guards.PostingOrderFavoursListing: Listing posting date is after the revocation posting date (Rev. Proc. 2018-32 s4.05-4.06)
guards.PlausibleDelta: Delta size inside historical range for the source and month
